teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a language teacher with 8 years of experience, my teaching strategy is to create an enjoyable learning environment. I teach individually and in groups. I’ve dealt with hundreds of students from all over the world and different cultures with pleasure. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, my aim is the same: to tailor my teaching style to suit your individual needs.
In my lessons, I provide both general and academic language support. I prefer communicative and lexical approaches.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
1) I will design a lesson plan for our classes tailored to your needs, which can be adjusted at any time.
2) Our class will start with some informal conversation before we dive into the main topic. I will introduce new vocabulary, use flashcards, explain details, and answer your questions. We will then engage in activities to practice the new knowledge through speaking, including making phrases, sentences, and dialogues. For grammar, I use visual aids such as tables, diagrams, and examples. If you are at a B1-B2 level, we can incorporate content-based activities, watch videos, read texts, and discuss new information.
3) I will provide you with feedback to track your progress.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Ready to take your language skills to the next level? Join my classes and let's embark on a journey together! Whether you want to improve for work, travel, or just for fun, my classes are tailored to your needs. With a supportive environment and personalized instruction, you'll gain the confidence to communicate effectively in no time.

Level Progression and Time Estimate:

A1 Beginner (60-80 hours)
•	Introduction to basic English vocabulary and grammar.
•	Simple conversations and greetings.
•	Reading and understanding basic texts.
•	Writing short sentences and paragraphs.

A2 Elementary (80-100 hours)
•	Expanding vocabulary and understanding more complex grammar structures.
•	Engaging in basic conversations on everyday topics.
•	Comprehending short texts and simple instructions.
•	Writing simple essays and emails.

B1 Pre-Intermediate (100-120 hours)
•	Developing conversational fluency on a wider range of topics.
•	Understanding more complex texts, such as articles and short stories.
•	Writing longer essays and reports with coherence and cohesion.
•	Expanding vocabulary for various contexts.

B2 Intermediate (120-150 hours)
•	Enhancing speaking skills for discussions, debates, and presentations.
•	Listening to and understanding native speakers in various situations.
•	Reading and analyzing longer texts, including news articles and excerpts from literature.
•	Writing coherent and structured essays, reports, and formal letters.

C1 Advanced (150-200 hours)
•	Refining speaking skills for advanced discussions, presentations, and negotiations.
•	Fine-tuning listening comprehension for nuanced understanding of native speakers.
•	Analyzing and synthesizing complex texts, including academic articles and literary works.
•	Producing well-structured and persuasive written pieces, such as essays, reports, and proposals.

pro_course_detail.title: English
pro_course_detail.description:
A1:

Can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type. Can introduce him/herself and others and can ask and answer questions about personal details such as where he/she lives, people he/she knows and things he/she has. Can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.
A2:

Can understand sentences and frequently used expressions related to areas of most immediate relevance. Can communicate in simple and routine tasks requiring a simple and direct exchange of information on familiar and routine matters. Can describe in simple terms aspects of his/her background, immediate environment and matters in areas of immediate need.
B1:

Can understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure, etc. Can deal with most situations likely to arise while travelling in an area where the language is spoken. Can produce simple connected text on topics which are familiar or of personal interest. Can describe experiences and events, dreams, hopes and ambitions and briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans.
B2:

Can understand the main ideas of complex texts on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in his/her field of specialisation. Can interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction with native speakers quite possible without strain for either party. Can produce clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects and explain a viewpoint on a topical issue giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options.

In my experience, knowing this global language has helped me feel confident abroad, make new friends, read articles, enjoy movies in their original language, and broaden my horizons.

teacher_info.teaching_style:

We will choose topics that interest you, or I will offer existential, thought-provoking, and unusual themes designed to spark discussions, debates, and storytelling—making lessons more engaging and intellectually stimulating.
All of this will help improve your vocabulary and speaking skills.

Currently, I'm pursuing a Master's degree in English Language and Literature in Vilnius, so I really understand what it’s like to be a student. Apart from languages, I am fond of travels, psychology, and arts. If you also share my interest in music, cinema, photography, or literature, we'll have plenty to talk about!
teacher_info.about_teacher:
Teaching is my passion, and that enthusiasm translates into my lessons. I've been teaching languages and literature for 8 years, so you can trust my professionalism. 
✅I have prepared 300 high school graduates for the complex Ukrainian language test for university enrolment. I am proud of my students' results and cherish the friendships we have built along the way.
✅ I have helped adult students improve their English for job opportunities, travel, and personal enrichment. I reached an advanced level of English mostly on my own, so I know the challenges of learning a new language and how to overcome them.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I believe that the best way to learn is by making the process enjoyable and relaxing. 
That is why I offer:
✅ Lessons tailored to your individual goals and learning pace.
✅ Interactive Sessions with fun language games and useful role-plays to help you remember the information better. 
✅ Focus on real-life scenarios and practical usage of the language. 
✅ Regular feedback and assessments to track your progress and identify areas for improvement.
✅ Immersion in Ukrainian/English culture through songs, texts, and videos that will enrich your learning experience. 
I look forward to welcoming you to my lessons and helping you achieve your language goals!🏅

course_info.trial_description:
It`s our first meeting, so let`s get to know each other better! We’ll start by learning some essential vocabulary that will be useful for our conversation. After getting acquainted, we’ll discuss your goals and language skills, and talk about your preferred learning style. From there, I’ll tailor a personalized study plan just for you.

I’m looking forward to our meeting! ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Ukrainian: Let's Begin!
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is perfect for those who are new to the Ukrainian language and want to build a solid foundation.

During this course, you will:
✅ Learn the Ukrainian alphabet and develop your reading skills.
✅ Master key grammar concepts, including genders, cases, tenses, and verb conjugations.
✅ Acquire essential vocabulary focused on real-life scenarios.
✅ Practice speaking on various everyday topics, such as hobbies, food, weather, family, travel, daily routines, shopping, and more.
🌻 Immerse yourself in Ukrainian culture through songs, poems, and videos that will enrich your learning experience.
✅ Apply what you've learned with optional additional tasks (flashcards, short stories, exercises, etc) to complete at home.

Ready to start your journey to learning Ukrainian? Book you trial and take the first step towards mastering this beautiful language with me! ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Ukrainian: Let's Talk!
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for those who already have a certain level of knowledge in Ukrainian but want to improve their speaking skills.

What I offer:
✅ Conversation Practice: Boost your fluency and confidence in discussing topics that interest you. All our lessons will focus on subjects you are passionate about, making learning more engaging and enjoyable.
✅ Targeted Grammar Support: Focus on complex grammar rules and structures, instantly integrating them into your active use.
✅ Boost Vocabulary: Receive customized vocabulary lists for each topic, allowing you to enrich your vocabulary effectively.

Ready to take your Ukrainian skills to the next level? Book your trial and let’s improve your speaking skills together! ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Personalized English Language Learning ✨
pro_course_detail.description:
With this course, you'll receive individualized lessons tailored to your level of proficiency and preferences. 

What do I offer:
✅ Customized Topics: Choose your topics of interest from a wide range of areas during our trial session. 
Whether you're looking to improve your career skills, discuss lifestyle and relationships, explore arts and travel, or understand the latest in science and technology, there's something for everyone.
✅ Integrated Lessons: Each session includes reading, grammar, listening, and speaking activities, all focused on your chosen topic.

Ready to take your English skills to the next level? Book your trial and start your journey towards fluency. I look forward to helping you achieve your learning goals! ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Ukrainian Language and Literature 📚
pro_course_detail.description:
If you want to enhance your Ukrainian language skills while reading your favourite books, this is the perfect course for you! 

📚 We can explore both books originally written in Ukrainian and those translated into Ukrainian. 
📚 If choosing a book seems challenging, you can start with a book that I recommend. I will provide the book and all necessary materials.

During this course, you will:
✅ Expand your vocabulary through the rich and diverse language used in literature.
✅ Understand and practice grammar structures as they naturally occur in texts.
✅ Improve your reading skills by engaging with various texts.
✅ Enhance your speaking skills by participating in thoughtful discussions about the themes, characters, and contexts of the readings.
✅ Apply what you've learned with optional additional tasks to complete at home.

Ready to explore the Ukrainian language through literature? Book your trial and let's begin your unusual learning journey!

teacher_info.about_teacher:
Teaching is something I began doing back in 2008, and I have never regretted my choice to pursue this profession. Over the years, I have had students ranging in age from 6 to 72. Through all of my teaching experiences, I have come to believe that the human brain is a fascinating mystery, and everyone learns in their own unique way.

My aim as a teacher is not to interrupt your learning, but rather to motivate and facilitate your own personal learning journey. I believe that every student has the potential to achieve great things, and it is my job to help you reach your full potential.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
As a teacher, nothing brings me greater joy than seeing my students make real progress and achieve their goals. I am incredibly proud of those who put in the effort and do a great job. That's why I have a high standard for my students - I expect them to give it their all, 100 percent of the time.
I also believe that homework is a valuable tool for reinforcing what we learn in class. It helps to solidify the concepts and improve our skills. Don't worry if you're not quite ready for formal tutoring - I also offer informal sessions where you can relax and feel supported. This way, you can practice speaking and using the language without fear.
